question: Should this member-authored QA Lab control-plane change be accepted after it is refreshed against current `main` and its changed dashboard request/response contract is reviewed?
rationale: The PR carries the protected `maintainer` label and changes an operator-facing planning boundary; cleanup automation must not decide acceptance or closure.

options.title: Review and land the refreshed head
options.body: Confirm the shared planner remains the single source of truth and accept the rebased branch once required validation is current.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Keep the central mixed-kind dispatch repair and move any nonessential dashboard-control expansion into a separately scoped PR.

recommendation.title: Review and land the refreshed head
recommendation.body: Confirm the shared planner remains the single source of truth and accept the rebased branch once required validation is current.
